product_family: AI-powered search/answer engine and coding assistant for developers (web app at phind.com plus a VS Code/JetBrains extension and API); the company ceased operations and shut the product down in January 2026.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. phind.com now returns a "404: NOT_FOUND / Code: DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND" error; the vendor's infrastructure has been decommissioned and no trust center, security page, or certification page could be found on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any phind.com/phind.io/phind-ai.com property. A third-party SaaS-security aggregator (Nudge Security) lists Phind as "ISO 27001 Compliant," but that page is not vendor-published, cites no source document, and could not be corroborated on any phind-controlled domain.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence available; the vendor's privacy policy (previously at phind.com/privacy) is no longer reachable because the site has been taken down.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. The same third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) also lists "HIPAA Compliant," "PCI Compliant," "FedRAMP Compliant," and "CSA Star Level 1 Compliant" for Phind with no supporting vendor documentation found anywhere.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. The same unverified third-party aggregator claim noted for HIPAA compliance applies to PCI DSS as well.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI-management-system certification for Phind was found on any vendor property or in press coverage.

privacy.ai_training_note: Phind's own privacy policy and security pages are no longer reachable (site returns a Vercel "DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND" 404), so no current vendor-sourced statement on training use of customer data could be verified. Independent reporting confirms the company deleted all saved user searches and chat histories as part of the shutdown, but that is a deletion/offboarding action, not a training-use disclosure.
privacy.data_region: n/a - not verified; vendor infrastructure is decommissioned

security.name: Vendor site / trust center availability
security.value: phind.com currently serves a Vercel platform 404 ("DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND") rather than the product; no security, privacy, or trust-center page is reachable on the vendor's own domain.

security.name: Operational status
security.value: Company shut down the Phind service on January 16, 2026 (roughly a month after closing a $10.4M Series A in December 2025), citing commoditization of AI developer search by foundation-model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google adding native web search/coding). Pro subscribers received prorated refunds; users were given until January 30, 2026 to export chat history before servers and all saved data were wiped.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Not verified - no live vendor page to confirm current TLS/security posture, since the product and its documentation are offline.

products.name: Phind (web search/answer engine)
products.data_scope: Previously handled user search queries and conversational history; all such data was deleted by the vendor around January 30, 2026 as part of shutdown.
products.notes: Service discontinued; no longer operational as of this review.

products.name: Phind Pro (paid subscription)
products.data_scope: Same as free tier plus any paid-account billing data; subscribers received prorated refunds at shutdown.
products.notes: Discontinued along with the base product.

products.name: Phind IDE extensions / API
products.category: Developer tooling (VS Code/JetBrains integration, API access)
products.data_scope: Not independently verified; assumed discontinued alongside the core service given full infrastructure teardown.
products.notes: No live evidence found; listed for completeness based on the product's historical scope.

compare.pricing_model: n/a - service discontinued; formerly freemium with a Phind Pro paid tier
compare.data_residency: n/a - not verified; vendor infrastructure decommissioned

flags: Independent reporting (Hacker News, Devtalk, intelligenttools.co, and a public statement from an early adopter on X) consistently confirms Phind shut down operations on January 16, 2026 and deleted all user data by January 30, 2026.

A third-party SaaS-security aggregator (Nudge Security) lists Phind as compliant with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR Level 1 with no cited source document and no corroboration on any phind-controlled domain. This looks like an auto-generated or inferred profile rather than a vendor-confirmed fact.

Multiple phind-branded domains exist: phind.com is the AI search product covered here and is now defunct; phind.io and phindwork.com appear to be an unrelated recruiting/staffing brand; phind-ai.com appears to be an unrelated third-party 'alternative' site. Privacy and security claims from phind.io, phindwork.com, or phind-ai.com do not apply to this AI search product.
No historical vendor-domain record (such as a web archive) could confirm pre-shutdown certification claims one way or the other.
